title: Chrono24 Listing Status Mix
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chrono24:listing
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(listing_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Chrono24 listing feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `listing_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces the overall mood of your Chrono24 listing feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
